purpose: Teach: フレッツ/エンタテイメント/ラストシーン/ポッドキャスティング/ヤンキース/ソフトボール/ホステス/タッグ
target_vocab: ポッドキャスティング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが我が家のフレッツ光の契約を見直して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — your dad is going to look over the Flets contract for us.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender. Slight lift at the end like she's sharing something that touched her. Slow pace, present and grounded. Voice carries quiet affection for both of them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとエンタテイメント施設に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went to an entertainment center with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, conversational energy. Eager to share. Natural child rhythm — not rushing but animated. Small smile in the voice. Direct eye contact in the tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが映画のラストシーンを優しく解説して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad explained the ending of the film so gently to me.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. Noticing something tender that happened. Slower pace. Slight trailing-off at the end — lingering on the memory. Voice full of recognition.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとポッドキャスティング番組を聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I listened to a podcast with Dad.
lines.style: Quick, enthusiastic. Eager to keep the conversation going. Natural child cadence — not breathless but genuinely animated. Light, unforced tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヤンキースの応援グッズを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad gave me Yankees merchandise.
lines.style: Warm, gentle surprise in the voice. Slight wonder — like he's still processing the kindness. Slower, more tender pace than before. Soft closing on the gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとソフトボールでキャッチボールしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I played catch with a softball.
lines.style: Energetic, present. That eager-to-share rhythm of a child. Slightly faster pace. Light, genuine happiness — no performance, just warmth in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ホステス文学にも社会描写がある」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad taught me that even hostess fiction has social commentary in it.
lines.style: Slightly awed, taking in something he didn't expect. Slower pace. Noticing the care it took for his dad to explain this. Soft, thoughtful delivery — he's still turning it over.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと友達とタッグを組んだ事を話したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I told Dad about teaming up with a friend.
lines.style: Warm, close, intimate. Child-voice contentment. Slightly softer than the earlier eager lines — this one has settled affection in it. Natural, unrushed pace.
